body:
Walkthrough

Adds `bin/cr-full-review`, a Bash CLI that opens review-only pull requests for full repositories or selected paths. It can wait for CodeRabbit reviews, save review findings and close pull requests with branch cleanup. **Changes: Review pull request workflow** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Build and open a review pull request**
`bin/cr-full-review`|The `open` command resolves a repository and revision, then uses the full tree or selected paths to create review commits. Unless `--dry-run` is set, it pushes branches and creates a labelled review pull request.| |**Wait for the CodeRabbit review**
`bin/cr-full-review`|The `wait` command polls for CodeRabbit review activity. It requests a review once after 10 minutes and exits with an error after 45 minutes.| |**Save findings and clean up**
`bin/cr-full-review`|The `findings` command saves review bodies and thread comments to a cache file. The `close` command saves findings, checks branch names, closes the pull request and deletes both branches. Command dispatch handles the supported commands and help.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes **Change:** Other **Possibly related PRs** - [kleinbem/coderabbit#17](https://github.com/kleinbem/coderabbit/pull/17): Defines the `cr-review` label gate that this CLI applies to its review pull requests and describes the manual review trigger used by its wait command.
Merge Risk: Low · up to 8387b

This adds a CLI for requesting full-repository CodeRabbit reviews. It has several edge-case failures, such as dot-prefixed paths, more than 30 reviews, interrupted exports and partial cleanup retries. These affect only the helper's own workflow and have workarounds, so the risk of merging is low. Fixing them before regular use is worthwhile.

**Explanation** The title names a full cr-full-review review and the no-merge intent. The changeset adds bin/cr-full-review, a CLI for requesting whole-repository CodeRabbit reviews through temporary PRs. The title reflects the PR purpose, but the main change is the new script, and the title frames it as a review request.

performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
